summary: Hagerty voted against disapproving arms sales to Israel (S.J.Res. 32, April 2026) and drew AIPAC PAC's 2026 endorsement for blocking three such measures. He opposed Palestinian state recognition, called any Gaza ceasefire a win for Hamas, framed the crisis as Hamas propaganda, co-led a bicameral statement blocking a U.S. Palestinian consulate, backed a resolution embracing the IHRA definition, and co-introduced legislation to withhold U.S. funds from UNRWA. Vote for Peace opposed his 2026 campaign.
